title: Banjir dan longsor Jabodetabek–Banten awal Januari 2020
status_note: Core event and headline figures supported by BNPB figures as reported by national media and BMKG statements as reported by media. Not yet 'validated': BNPB primary situation report and BMKG primary release not yet archived in data/raw. Figures evolved over days; values below are tied to their report date.

regency_city_documented.evidence: Sukajaya (Kab. Bogor) visited by the President during response — Kontan 2020-01-07
BPBD Banten reported deaths from flooding in Lebak — Tirto (headline)

regency_city_note: DKI Jakarta impacts are recorded at province level (63 flood points) in sources retrieved so far; per-kota breakdown NOT_PUBLISHED in retrieved sources.

real_facts.fact: Rainfall of 377 mm/day recorded at Halim Perdanakusuma (East Jakarta), 31 Dec 2019 evening to 1 Jan 2020; described by BMKG as the highest in the Jakarta-area measurement record (since 1866).
At least 169 flood points: Jawa Barat 97, DKI Jakarta 63, Banten 9; water depth 30 cm to 2.5 m (BNPB).

Casualty/evacuee totals per BNPB as of 2020-01-07: DKI Jakarta 16 dead / 3,685 evacuees; Jawa Barat 31 dead / 15,400 evacuees; Banten 20 dead, 1 missing / 16,821 evacuees. Total 67 dead, 1 missing, 35,502 evacuees; 293 villages in 74 subdistricts affected.
Earlier BNPB figures were lower (9 dead on 2020-01-01; 16 dead shortly after) — totals rose as reports came in.

trigger: extreme rainfall over the new-year night
